newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-BECKER GETS TOUGH DRAW AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER GETS TOUGH DRAW AT WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Defending champion Boris Becker was given a tough draw for this week's ATP world championship on Monday when he was put in the same round-robin group as world number one Pete Sampras and Andre Agassi.
The top eight players at the season-ending tournament play in two round-robin groups of four players with the top two advancing to the semifinals.
Becker and Sampras and Agassi were joined by French Open champion Yevgeny Kafelnikov in the red group.
American world number two Michael Chang was the top player in the white group with Croat Goran Ivanisevic , Austrian Thomas Muster and Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek.
Becker plays his opening match on Tuesday against Kafelnikov. Chang plays Krajicek and Muster meets Ivanisevic in the other two clashes of the day.
